items.title: News for England North – 25 October 2026
items.summary: The OPS-2m-NW Net is a regular VHF simplex net for licensed amateur radio operators across North West England, organised and run by the M0KKN Club. items.title: News for Scotland – 25 October 2026
items.summary: The Fourteenth Scottish Microwave Round Table GMRT-2026 takes place on Saturday at the Museum of Communication, Burntisland, Fife.
